Repairing request cleanup

The maintainers published an engineering report about delayed cleanup fixes and the testing work needed to ship them.

Request cleanup must inspect only fully initialized entries. When an allocation fails between publishing a new entry and initializing its fields, cleanup can observe partial state. The fix must preserve the ownership boundary across every early return and allocation failure. Existing callers rely on the previous behavior, so the implementation requires careful compatibility checks. Reproducing this failure needs deterministic allocation injection and independent assertions about which fields are visible. The team added focused failure scenarios and reviewed the shared cleanup routine before shipping the correction.
